streams.title: Account balances
streams.description: Authenticated balance updates for one root account or subaccount. JSON uses decimal amount strings; Protobuf uses unsigned 128-bit amount parts.

parameters.name: accountPublicId
parameters.description: Public root account or subaccount identifier authorized by the subscription token.

available.description: Spendable trading amount, computed as max(trading minus reserved, 0), in asset units as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits.

funding.description: Funding balance in asset units as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits.

fundingUpdatedAtNs.description: Funding-balance source timestamp in Unix nanoseconds (UTC), encoded as an exact decimal string. "0" means not yet observed.

reserved.description: Amount reserved from the trading balance in asset units as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits.

reservedUpdatedAtNs.description: Reserved-balance source timestamp in Unix nanoseconds (UTC), encoded as an exact decimal string. "0" means not yet observed.

symbol.description: Unified asset symbol for these balances.

trading.description: Trading balance in asset units as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits.

tradingUpdatedAtNs.description: Trading-balance source timestamp in Unix nanoseconds (UTC), encoded as an exact decimal string. "0" means not yet observed.

streams.title: Ledger transfers
streams.description: Authenticated committed ledger transfer updates for one root account or subaccount. JSON uses decimal amount strings.

parameters.name: accountPublicId
parameters.description: Public root account or subaccount identifier authorized by the subscription token.

accountId.description: Public root-account or subaccount identifier when this side is safe to identify. Omitted for private or non-user sides.

address.description: External wallet or Polyester smart-account address when known and safe to expose. Omitted otherwise.

kind.description: Side category: FUNDING_ACCOUNT, TRADING_ACCOUNT, EXTERNAL_ADDRESS, PRIVATE_COUNTERPARTY, FEE_ACCOUNT, or SYSTEM_ACCOUNT.

account.description: Account bucket affected by this row: FUNDING or TRADING.

amount.description: Transferred amount in asset units as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits.

balanceAfter.description: Balance after this transfer in asset units as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits. Omitted when unavailable.

destination.description: Credit side of the transfer. Omitted when the side cannot be represented safely.

flowId.description: Public lifecycle flow identifier. Omitted when the transfer is not associated with a lifecycle flow.

isDebit.description: True when this row debits the subscribed account. Omitted for credit rows.

linkId.description: Identifier that groups related transfer legs, such as legs from one trade. Omitted when not applicable.

source.description: Debit side of the transfer. Omitted when the side cannot be represented safely.

symbol.description: Unified asset symbol for the transfer.

transferCode.description: Product reason for the transfer, such as DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, TRADE_BASE, TRADE_QUOTE, INTERNAL_TRANSFER, or a Funding/Trading movement.

streams.title: Spot order updates
streams.description: Authenticated spot order state updates for one root account or subaccount. JSON presents public identifiers, decimal quantities, and RFC 3339 timestamps.

parameters.name: accountPublicId
parameters.description: Public root account or subaccount identifier authorized by the subscription token.

oco.description: True when take-profit and the configured stop leg form a one-cancels-the-other pair. Omitted when false.

stopLoss.description: Stop-loss configuration and runtime state. Omitted when no stop-loss leg exists.

takeProfit.description: Take-profit configuration and runtime state. Omitted when no take-profit leg exists.

trailingStop.description: Trailing-stop configuration and runtime state. Omitted when no trailing-stop leg exists.

armedAt.description: Time the leg became armed as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to nanosecond precision. Omitted before arming.

childOrderId.description: Public identifier of the child order created when this leg fired. Omitted until a child exists.

status.description: Leg lifecycle status: CREATED, ARMED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, CANCELED, FAILED, or PAUSED. Omitted when unspecified.

terminalAt.description: Time the leg became terminal as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to nanosecond precision. Omitted before termination.

triggerId.description: Public identifier of the trigger backing this leg. Omitted when unavailable.

childSeq.description: Child sequence number for a multi-child trigger strategy. Omitted when not applicable.

parentOrderId.description: Public parent order identifier for an attached-risk child. Omitted otherwise.

scope.description: Broad creation source: DIRECT, ATTACHED_RISK, STANDALONE_TRIGGER, or SYSTEM. Omitted when unspecified.

triggerId.description: Public trigger identifier when the order was generated by a trigger. Omitted otherwise.

triggerType.description: Trigger strategy that generated the order: STOP_LOSS, TAKE_PROFIT, TRAILING_STOP, TWAP, or LADDER. Omitted for direct orders.

limitGtc.description: Selects a resting good-til-canceled limit child. Omitted when marketIoc is selected.

price.description: Child limit price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

marketIoc.description: Selects a market child with immediate-or-cancel behavior. Omitted when limitGtc is selected.

policy.description: Configured stop-loss policy. Omitted when only runtime state is available.

state.description: Current runtime state for the stop-loss leg. Omitted when state is unavailable.

child.description: Child-order execution used when the stop-loss threshold is crossed. Omitted when unavailable.

triggerPrice.description: Stop-loss trigger price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

policy.description: Configured take-profit policy. Omitted when only runtime state is available.

state.description: Current runtime state for the take-profit leg. Omitted when state is unavailable.

child.description: Child-order execution used when the take-profit threshold is crossed. Omitted when unavailable.

triggerPrice.description: Take-profit trigger price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

policy.description: Configured trailing-stop policy. Omitted when only runtime state is available.

state.description: Current runtime state for the trailing-stop leg. Omitted when state is unavailable.

activationPrice.description: Price at which trailing begins, in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Omitted when trailing starts immediately after the parent fills.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum protected-child slippage in basis points, where 1 bp is 0.01%. Omitted when price ticks or unprotected execution is used.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Maximum protected-child slippage as a count of 1e-6 quote-unit price ticks. Omitted when basis points or unprotected execution is used.

trailingDistanceBps.description: Trailing distance in basis points, where 1 bp is 0.01%. Omitted when a quote-unit distance is used.

trailingDistanceTicks.description: Trailing distance in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Omitted when basis points are used.

attachedRisk.description: Attached take-profit, stop-loss, or trailing-stop policy and runtime state. Omitted when no attached risk exists.

avgPx.description: Average fill price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Zero before the first fill.

clientOrderId.description: Client-provided idempotency and correlation identifier. Empty when none was supplied.

createdAt.description: Order creation time as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to nanosecond precision.

cumQty.description: Cumulative filled quantity in base-asset units as a decimal string using the market's configured quantity precision.

feeSource.description: Fee source selected for fills: QUOTE or RECEIVED.

leavesQty.description: Remaining working quantity in base-asset units as a decimal string. Zero for terminal orders.

marketClientRefPriceTicks.description: Client reference price for market-order slippage protection, in quote units scaled by 1e6 and encoded as an exact decimal integer string. Omitted when not supplied.

marketMaxSlippageBps.description: Maximum market-order slippage in basis points, where 1 bp is 0.01%. Omitted when price ticks or the market default is used.

marketMaxSlippageTicks.description: Maximum market-order slippage as a count of 1e-6 quote-unit price ticks. Omitted when basis points or the market default is used.

origQty.description: Original order quantity in base-asset units as a decimal string using the market's configured quantity precision.

origin.description: Order lineage describing whether it was direct or generated by attached risk, a standalone trigger, or system activity. Omitted when unavailable.

postOnly.description: True when the limit order must only add liquidity. Omitted when false.

price.description: Limit price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Zero for market orders.

side.description: Order side: BUY base asset or SELL base asset.

status.description: Current lifecycle status: PENDING, PENDING_CANCEL, WORKING, FILLED, CANCELED, or REJECTED.

stpMode.description: Self-trade prevention mode: EXPIRE_MAKER, EXPIRE_TAKER, or EXPIRE_BOTH.

symbol.description: Spot trading pair symbol, for example BTC-USDT.

terminalAt.description: Time the order became terminal as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to nanosecond precision. Omitted for open orders.

terminalReason.description: Stable cancellation or rejection reason name. Omitted for non-terminal orders and when unavailable.

terminalReasonCode.description: Stable numeric cancellation or rejection reason. Omitted for non-terminal orders and when unavailable.

tif.description: Time-in-force policy: GTC, IOC, or FOK.

version.description: Per-order state version, starting at 1 and increasing with each published state change. Use it to reconcile API and realtime updates.

streams.title: User trade executions
streams.description: Authenticated user trade executions for one root account or subaccount. JSON presents public identifiers, decimals, and RFC 3339 timestamps.

parameters.name: accountPublicId
parameters.description: Public root account or subaccount identifier authorized by the subscription token.

executedAt.description: Fill execution time as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to nanosecond precision.

fee.description: Fee amount as a decimal string in the asset selected by feeSource, using that asset's configured quantity precision.

feeSource.description: Asset used for the fee: QUOTE or RECEIVED. FEE_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED means no fee was charged.

isMaker.description: True when this fill was the resting maker side; false for the taker side.

matchId.description: Monotonic match identifier within the symbol, encoded as an exact decimal string.

orderId.description: Public opaque identifier of the filled order.

price.description: Execution price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

qty.description: Executed quantity in base-asset units as a decimal string using the market's configured quantity precision.

referralShare.description: Referral share as a decimal string in the same asset and precision as fee. Zero when none was allocated.

side.description: Filled order side: BUY or SELL.

symbol.description: Spot trading pair symbol, for example BTC-USDT.

streams.title: Trigger events
streams.description: Authenticated spot trigger fire, update, and cancellation events for one root account or subaccount.

parameters.name: accountPublicId
parameters.description: Public root account or subaccount identifier authorized by the subscription token.

childOrderId.description: Public identifier of the child order created by this event. Omitted when no child was created.

childSeq.description: Child sequence number for multi-child trigger strategies. Zero when not applicable.

eventType.description: Event category: EVENT_FIRED, EVENT_CANCELED, or EVENT_UPDATED.

firePx.description: Price that caused the trigger to fire, in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Zero when not applicable.

reason.description: Cancellation reason when provided. Omitted for other events or when no reason is available.

subaccountId.description: Public root-account or subaccount identifier associated with the trigger.

tsNs.description: Event time in Unix nanoseconds (UTC), encoded as an exact decimal string.

streams.description: Authenticated spot trigger state updates for one root account or subaccount.

parameters.name: accountPublicId
parameters.description: Public root account or subaccount identifier authorized by the subscription token.

streams.description: Public detail updates for one lifecycle flow, including its summary and ordered observed steps.

parameters.name: flowId
parameters.description: Public lifecycle flow identifier.

streams.title: Lifecycle flow summaries
streams.description: Public summary updates for open deposit, withdrawal, and transfer lifecycle flows.

streams.title: Zipped asset supply
streams.description: Public batched supply updates for changed zipped-asset routes. JSON uses decimal strings; Protobuf uses scaled integers.

updates.description: Latest absolute supply values for the zipped-asset routes changed in this batch; entries are not deltas.

supply.description: Latest zToken supply for the route in unified-asset units as a decimal string using the asset's configured quantity precision.

zippedAssetId.description: Canonical numeric identifier of the zipped-asset route.

streams.title: Public identity updates
streams.description: Public account username, avatar, and root smart-account identity updates.

streams.title: Current candles
streams.description: Public current-candle updates for one timeframe and spot symbol. JSON uses decimal strings; Protobuf uses scaled integers.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Candle interval: 1s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 1d, 1w, or 1mo.

parameters.name: symbolId
parameters.description: Numeric spot market symbol identifier.

close.description: Latest or closing price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

high.description: Highest traded price in the bucket in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

is_closed.description: True only for the terminal update emitted after the bucket closes; false for updates to the current open bucket.

low.description: Lowest traded price in the bucket in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

open.description: Opening price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

ts_sec.description: Candle bucket start time in Unix seconds (UTC).

volume.description: Traded base-asset quantity in the bucket as a decimal string with up to 18 fractional digits.

streams.title: Live L2 heatmap
streams.description: Public live orderbook heatmap buckets for one interval and spot symbol.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Heatmap interval: 1s, 1m, 5m, or 1h.

parameters.name: symbolId
parameters.description: Numeric spot market symbol identifier.

streams.title: Market overview
streams.description: Public batched spot-market ticker and best-quote updates for all changed markets.

streams.title: Market trades
streams.description: Public executed spot trades for one symbol. JSON presents decimal amounts and an RFC 3339 execution timestamp.

parameters.name: symbolId
parameters.description: Numeric spot market symbol identifier.

executedAt.description: Trade execution time as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to nanosecond precision.

matchId.description: Monotonic trade identifier within the symbol, encoded as an exact decimal string.

price.description: Trade price in quote-asset units as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits.

qty.description: Traded quantity in base-asset units as a decimal string using the market's configured quantity precision.

side.description: Taker or aggressor side: BUY when the taker bought the base asset, otherwise SELL.

symbol.description: Spot trading pair symbol, for example BTC-USDT.

streams.title: Orderbook deltas
streams.description: Public spot orderbook SET-style deltas for one symbol and depth tier. Bootstrap from the orderbook snapshot API and refetch after sequence gaps.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Published depth tier. Supported values are 1, 20, 50, 200, and 500.

parameters.name: symbolId
parameters.description: Numeric spot market symbol identifier.

asks.description: Ask-side SET updates as [price, quantity] decimal-string tuples. A zero quantity deletes the price level. Omitted when no ask levels changed.

prefixItems.description: Price in quote-asset units with up to six fractional digits.
Quantity in base-asset units using the market's configured precision; zero deletes the level.

bids.description: Bid-side SET updates as [price, quantity] decimal-string tuples. A zero quantity deletes the price level. Omitted when no bid levels changed.

prefixItems.description: Price in quote-asset units with up to six fractional digits.
Quantity in base-asset units using the market's configured precision; zero deletes the level.

bookSeqEnd.description: Ending monotonic book sequence after applying this update.

bookSeqStart.description: Starting monotonic book sequence covered by this update. It may be 0 when reset is true.

reset.description: When true, clear the local book before applying this message; the level arrays contain the current view for the subscribed depth tier.

ts.description: Best-effort timestamp associated with the book update in Unix milliseconds (UTC). Omitted when unavailable.
